instagram.caption:
While making Stardew Valley alone, Eric Barone worked part-time as a theater usher just to get by.

For over four years his girlfriend Amber paid most of the bills, while he did the code, art, music and writing himself.

Stardew Valley came out in 2016 and has now sold over 40 million copies. Barone has promised he will never charge for a DLC or update, as long as he lives. Every major update so far has been free.

Did you know this story?
